note: Frozen contract for the OpenCode wire message-id clock. The implementation is packages/sdk/src/core/session/wire-message-id.ts (the `@kortix/sdk/wire-message-id` subpath). apps/api (src/projects/wire-message-id.ts) and apps/mobile (lib/session/wire-message-id.ts) re-export it and run these vectors through their own names; apps/api compares clocks only through wireIdClockDelta and maxWireIdClock. The one remaining copy is the pi harness in kortixd (apps/kortix-sandbox-agent-server/src/harness/pi/wire-id.ts), a standalone binary with no workspace dependencies; its test asserts its ids match this module's regex and runs `vectors` (dated backdateMs earlier, since pi mints with no backdate) and `delta` against its own ring compare. packages/sdk/src/core/session/wire-id-unwrap.ts (internal) unwraps the clock for display ordering from this module's constants. `vectors` pins the mint; `newest` pins the ordering of transcript ids, including the prefix rule (an id counts by its 12 lowercase-hex prefix, whatever its tail); `delta` pins the signed ring distance between two clocks. The 48-bit clock wraps every 2^36 ms; the last wrap was 2026-08-14T11:19:55.136Z (nowMs 1786706395136 + offsets below).
format: msg_ + the low 48 bits of (clockMs * 0x1000) as 12 lowercase hex chars + 14 random base62 chars

vectors.name: no history: the backdated wall clock alone
history far below the clock: no lift
history above the clock, inside the correction bound: lift to newest+1
history exactly at the backdated clock: still lifts by one
history beyond the 1h correction bound: ignored
tolerance edge: history exactly 1h above the backdated clock still lifts
tolerance edge: history 1h + 1 tick above the backdated clock is ignored
wrap: clock just below the wrap, history above it and still below the wrap: lift
wrap: history is the last clock value before the wrap: the lift wraps to zero
wrap: clock just below the wrap, history just after it: the lift crosses the wrap
wrap: tolerance edge across the wrap, history exactly 1h above: lift
wrap: tolerance edge across the wrap, history 1h + 1 tick above: ignored
wrap: clock just after the wrap, history just before it: history is behind, no lift
wrap: backdated clock exactly at the wrap, no history: zero

newest.name: no id in the wire format: null
wrap: ids on both sides of the wrap: the post-wrap id is newest
with now: an id more than 1h ahead of now is skipped
wrap: with now just before the wrap, an id seconds past the wrap is newest
prefix rule: an id with a hex clock prefix but a non-wire tail still counts by its clock
format rule: an uppercase-hex or non-hex prefix is not a clock

delta.name: no wrap: clock ahead of reference
wrap: a post-wrap clock is ahead of a pre-wrap reference
wrap: a pre-wrap clock is behind a post-wrap reference
